text: The program is designed to help students who have a high proficiency in Chinese to acquire a comprehensive knowledge of modern China's economic environment in a short period of time. At present, the program is divided into two sub-programs (A and B) as detailed below. Generally speaking, Program A starts in fall and Program B in spring. Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion. Programs Offered (Each semester's curriculum will act according to the actual situation to make adjustment) Program A 1) China's Foreign Trade and WTO 2) Managerial Theory of China's Business Management 3) Introduction to Chinese Finance 4) Introduction to Chinese Economics 5) China's Fiscal and Financial Policies & Taxation Law 6) Advanced Business ChineseⅠ 7) Business Newspaper ReadingⅠ Program B 1) Lectures on China's Hot Business Topics 2) Management of China's Foreign Currencies 3) Chinese Law on Foreign Trade 4) Chinese Foreign Trade Practice 5) Introduction to Investment in China 6) Advanced Business ChineseⅡ 7) Business Newspaper ReadingⅡ 2.Application Period Fall Semester: April – August 31st Spring Semester: October – November 30 3. Tuition For the first semester is CNY 9,900/person and CNY 9,100/peron for each subsequent semester. (Advance payment of CNY 2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester) 4. Certificate Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion
